title: Core Consumer Surface Freeze
summary: Core commit 5892df6e542a02b25ae3b18ee02a55842b83d48f adds a Core-owned JSON-safe consumer surface freeze contract that distinguishes current private root and fixture entrypoints, planned-not-exported subpath groups, supported consumer surfaces, retained transition or migration surfaces, and blocked Backend/Editor/frontend ownership leaks.
expectedOutput: A Core-owned, JSON-safe consumer surface freeze contract and tests that distinguish supported Backend, Editor, and future frontend imports from retained, deprecated, or blocked surfaces, followed by a Project Control evidence record after Core verification.
riskSummary: Core root exports remain broad and Core broad truth remains unknown. The freeze blocks direct future frontend Core imports until Backend document records or an Editor-owned adapter boundary are selected, but it does not stage Backend replacement import paths, Editor test import policy, production Backend readiness, or deployed compatibility.
